title: Tensor construction and relative annihilator bound
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $A,D$ be finitely presented $R$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Let $\Lambda$ be an $R$-algebra, $\pi\in R$, and $\alpha:A\to\Lambda$, $\delta:D\to\Lambda$ be $R$-algebra maps. Assume $\operatorname{Ann}_\Lambda(\pi)=\operatorname{Ann}_\Lambda(\pi^2)$, that the image of $\pi$ in $A$ is strictly standard over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-strictly-standard-element], and that an $R$-algebra map $A/\pi^4A\to D/\pi^4D$ commutes with the maps to $\Lambda/\pi^4\Lambda$. Write $p$ for the image of $\pi$ in $D$ and $T=\{r\in D\mid\forall x\in D,\ p^2x=0\Rightarrow rpx=0\}$. There are a commutative $R$-algebra $B$ and $R$-algebra maps $\beta:B\to\Lambda$, $a_B:A\to B$, $d_B:D\to B$ such that $\beta a_B=\alpha$, $\beta d_B=\delta$, $B$ is finitely presented over $D$ via $d_B$, and the ideal generated by $d_B(T)$ is contained in $H_{B/D}$ [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal]. No comparison with $H_{D/R}$ or $H_{B/R}$ is asserted.

proof.text: Setup over $D$. Write $\alpha:A\to\Lambda$, $\delta:D\to\Lambda$ for the given maps and $\varphi:A/\pi^4A\to D/\pi^4D$ for the map of (2). Since $D$ is of finite presentation, hence of finite type, over the Noetherian ring $R$, $D$ is Noetherian [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra-noetherian]. Put $A'=A\otimes_RD$, a $D$-algebra via $d\mapsto1\otimes d$; it is of finite presentation over $D$ [lem-weil-pbc-finite-presentation-base-change-composition](1) (with $R'=D$, $S=A$; $A\otimes_RD\cong D\otimes_RA$). Regard $\Lambda$ as a $D$-algebra via $\delta$. The map $\alpha':A'\to\Lambda$, $a\otimes d\mapsto\alpha(a)\delta(d)$, is well defined ($R$-bilinear in $(a,d)$ because $\alpha,\delta$ are $R$-algebra maps) and is a homomorphism of $D$-algebras (universal property of the tensor product of commutative algebras), with $\alpha'(a\otimes1)=\alpha(a)$ and $\alpha'(1\otimes d)=\delta(d)$. We use the image $\pi_D$ of $\pi$ in $D$; its image in $A'$ is $1\otimes\pi_D=\pi_A\otimes1$ ($\pi_A$ the image of $\pi$ in $A$), and its image in $\Lambda$ under $\delta$ is the image of $\pi$ under $R\to\Lambda$.

proof.text: The hypotheses of [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-desingularize] hold for the Noetherian base ring $D$, the $D$-algebra $\Lambda$, the element $\pi_D\in D$, the $D$-algebra $A'$ of finite presentation and $\alpha':A'\to\Lambda$. (a) $\mathrm{Ann}_\Lambda(\pi_D)=\mathrm{Ann}_\Lambda(\pi_D^2)$: $\pi_D$ acts on $\Lambda$ as $\pi$ does, and this is the hypothesis on $\Lambda$. (b) $\pi_A$ is strictly standard in $A$ over $R$ by (1), so its image $\pi_A\otimes1$, which is the image of $\pi_D$ in $A'$, is strictly standard in $A'$ over $D$ by [lem-weil-pbc-strictly-standard-base-change] (with $R'=D$). (c) The section: the map $A'\to D/\pi^4D$, $a\otimes d\mapsto\varphi(\bar a)\bar d$ ($\bar a$ the class of $a$ in $A/\pi^4A$, $\bar d$ that of $d$), is a homomorphism of $D$-algebras by the universal property of the tensor product (the composite $A\to A/\pi^4A\xrightarrow{\varphi}D/\pi^4D$ and the reduction $D\to D/\pi^4D$ are $R$-algebra maps); it kills $\pi_D^4A'$ because $\pi_D^4\mapsto0$, so it induces a homomorphism of $D$-algebras $\rho:A'/\pi_D^4A'\to D/\pi_D^4D$. Its composite with $D/\pi^4D\to\Lambda/\pi^4\Lambda$ (induced by $\delta$) sends the class of $a\otimes d$ to $(\text{image of }\varphi(\bar a))\cdot\overline{\delta(d)}=\overline{\alpha(a)}\,\overline{\delta(d)}=\overline{\alpha'(a\otimes d)}$, using that $\varphi$ is compatible with the maps to $\Lambda/\pi^4\Lambda$; as the elements $a\otimes d$ generate $A'$ additively, the composite is the map induced by $\alpha'$, which is condition (2) of [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-desingularize]. In Lean construct the map σ:D⊗_R A→D/(p⁴) with AlgHom.liftEquiv, and descend with Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ since σ(p⁴)=0. Construct δq:D/(p⁴)→Λ/(π⁴Λ) the same way. TensorProduct.ext_ring reduces δq∘σ=(quotient map)∘α′ to the A-factor; choose a representative d of φ(a) and apply the given representative compatibility. Evaluating this map equality proves the section compatibility on every tensor element.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-desingularize] over $D$ to the tensor algebra and compatible section from the preceding steps. It gives a finitely presented $D$-algebra $B$ and a factorization of the tensor map with $\mathfrak a B\subset H_{B/D}$, where $\mathfrak a$ consists exactly of the $r\in D$ satisfying $p^2x=0\Rightarrow rpx=0$ for every $x\in D$, with $p$ the image of $\pi$. Restrict the tensor inclusion to $A$ and $D$ and restrict scalars of the map to $\Lambda$. On pure tensors these maps recover $\alpha$ and $\delta$, giving the two composite equalities. Retain finite presentation over $D$; do not yet assert either singular-ideal comparison. The result of Tag 07CR lies in Type(max w z), so take the actual ring construction U=ULift B to reach Type(max u v w z), and equip it with the transported D- and R-algebra structures. FinitePresentation.equiv transports finite presentation. Compose the factorization maps with the ULift algebra equivalence and its inverse; the two composite identities follow by evaluation on 1⊗a and by the D-algebra map law. Ideal.map_span and the commutation of the equivalence with algebraMap identify the extended annihilator ideal with the image of its ideal in B. Apply Ideal.map_mono to the bound in B and then [lem-weil-pbc-singular-ideal-map-equiv] to obtain the bound in U. Algebra.algebra_ext identifies the D-algebra structure induced by dU with the canonical transported one.
